dish: Fukagawa-meshi — asari clams in sweet Edo-style miso broth poured over rice (bukkake), or clams cooked into the rice (takikomi)
address: By Tomioka Hachimangū, Monzen-Nakachō, Kōtō-ku, Tokyo
w: The go-to for Fukagawa-meshi, the late-Edo fishermen's clam rice of this old fishing district — the poured-over version is made fresh to order with richly sweet miso and freshly harvested clams.
